description: Engine QA fixture for BookWorld-5mv's evidence-cataloging mechanic. Exercises every branch the schema supports: a co-located spatial pair (auto-merged into one walk-up point, testing the 'inspecting reveals sub-entries' behaviour), a standalone spatial item, a carried-equipment item (never a world point), and a non-spatial case fact that reveals once all spatial evidence is logged. No story content — the text below is deliberately generic.

items.name: Test artifact A
items.description: A gray-box desk prop, used as the primary item in a co-located pair.
items.catalogEntry: Artifact A logged: desk-top item, no further detail.

items.name: Test artifact A — close detail
items.description: Co-located with test-item-a; should surface as a sub-entry from the SAME walk-up interaction, not a separate point.
items.catalogEntry: Detail sub-entry revealed alongside artifact A.

items.name: Test artifact B
items.description: A gray-box cabinet prop, a standalone (non-co-located) spatial item.

items.name: Test kit (carried)
items.description: Player-carried equipment per the schema ruling — never a walk-to-inspect point, surfaced as HUD/equipment info only.

items.name: Scene-complete case fact
items.description: Non-spatial case fact; reveals as a HUD toast + catalog entry once all spatial evidence (test-item-a, test-item-a-detail, test-item-b) is logged.
items.catalogEntry: All spatial evidence catalogued in this room — case fact revealed.
